birth.date_confidence: attested only by Bradshaw's own entry in Who's Who in America, vol. 2 (1901-1902), p. 124, which he supplied himself; later reference works repeat it. No town, parish, or townland within County Down has been located and no baptismal record found. The widely circulated claim that he was brought to America in infancy is rejected as mistaken by the Encyclopedia of Science Fiction, and is contradicted by his Irish schooling, his 1877 prize, his 1878 appointment, and his children's Belfast births.
